name: online_fallback
description: For jobs this PC can't do locally (heavy media and conversions): finds a free online tool (reusing ones that worked before, from the 'online_fallbacks_used' registry), asks before uploading the owner's file, runs the tool in the owner's main Chrome, and saves the result.
route: do a job on a file with a free online tool or website, when it can't be done on this PC
